Player Impressions:
Hoyos - Saved the game for Atlanta at the end.
Edwards - Something is off with his game.  Positioning, passing, clearances.  May not be at the full speed of the 1st team.
Jacob - largely quiet today
Alonso - not fast enough and easily beaten.  Reads the game well and moves up to clear the ball often.
Báez - has been pushing up higher.  But also doesn't go as far down the wing as earlier in the season.  Keeps better defensive positioning.
Gill - phenominal in his debut.  Shows a lot of class in his ability to read the game.  Best midfielder of the game for Atlanta.  Looking forward to future games.
Muyumba - He's a game-changer.  Generally slow to react/pass.  But will turn up his game for a bit.  When he does, he's electric.  Turned Atlanta around.
Sanchez - I enjoy his game.  His defending, his passing.  And yet, he's not up to speed right now.  Needs a bit more.  
Miranchuk - His distribution is good backwards and sideways.  Not as good to the front man.  He needs to see the runner's movement to know where to pass.
Almirón - Atlanta's heart and soul for the team.  Tries everything, runs himself into the ground.  Trying everything.  Motivates the team.
Picault - Better today as winger than as striker.  Gets himself into good positions.  Tires easily now and can't do a full game.
Stian - his norm - when healthy, is a good defender.  reads an attack well and always gets in the way of a cross.
Brennan - played defensively to help preserve the lead.  put his body on the line.
Santos - fought hard a few times.  Helped slow the game down.  Wasn't able to generate an attack.
